note: Re-implementation of the DPMM normative model of Schulthess & Konukoglu (MICCAI 2025): L2-normalised DINOv2 patch embeddings, Dirichlet-process Gaussian mixture (variational, diagonal covariance) replacing the explicit memory bank; slice score = top-5 percent mean of per-patch Mahalanobis distances to the nearest retained component centre. Not the official implementation. PCA to 128 dimensions applied before fitting for tractability. Aggregation operator held fixed so that only the normal-space model differs.
